reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: This has everything I need AND they're accessible, I love the tabs for notes, calendar, etc that are so easy to find. I don't need to flip through page after page to find a section. The google calendar integration means I can see what's going on at work, so this app is now my all in one for work and life. It makes the work/life balance a snap. I can't wait to see if you come up with a few more pen and pencil styles (I love a pencil when taking notes). I was searching for a planner/journal that gave me options but not so many that I went down the template rabbit hole. NAILED IT.

reviews.title: Payment issues
reviews.text: Love the app. However, I was charged $50, when it clearly says $29.99. Then I cancelled the subscription so I wouldn’t be charged next year. That gives me a year to decide if I like the app still. And now it’s telling me to restore my payment. There’s no way y’all are ripping people off. This has to be a glitch. I’ll give you the benefit of the doubt. But seriously, fix my stuff please.

reviews.title: The App is good but not usable across devices
reviews.text:
Plus their support is absolutely terrible.  I have emailed them three times now with zero response.  Emailed directly and through their website.  They cancelled my account before my year had expired - DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS BOGUS APP.  I’m out $30 right now.

I am running this on my iPad which works well.  I tried to access it on my phone to check what I needed to do that day and was prompted to pay again for that copy.  This is NOT cross platform compatible - if that is important to you, then I would use a different one.

There is a 7 day trial and I thought that they would respond to my question before that ended but they did not so I was charged.  But it fits my needs right now on my iPad .  I just do not plan on renewing after the year is up.  There are better option!

reviews.title: Useful & practical
reviews.text: Great app for keeping daily weekly and monthly agenda. The notes feature is awesome, just open notes page and begin. I only gave it a 3 because it has a few difficulties that should be fixed. When you zoom in on screen size it sometimes gets glitchy and have to restart app to get the full size back. Also, highlighter covers ink color, does not go behind it. Events listed on day, week, or month do not show on all of them -would be best if daily event would show on all calendar options. Finally, importing google calendar works but can be glitchy and list items twice or have dates offset by a day or so. Otherwise useful and practical app.

reviews.title: Great way to combine digital and handwriting on one system
reviews.text:
I like to plan out things on paper by hand. It’s much more flexible when it is in the digital domain to erase and quickly re-draw things. Overlaying all of that on a daily / weekly / yearly / monthly calendar is perfect. I think this product knocks it out of the park. A few things I would like to see in a future version are homemade templates that I can interleave with my calendar notes. And get rid of that book folder, which adds no value 
allow a erasing by stroke rather than the entire object.
Great solution overall. Keep up the good work. This app now gets a prominent position on my front page in my mini Apple tablet and on my iPhone 16.

reviews.title: PERFECT SOLUTION
reviews.text:
After years of trying to find the quickest & easiest solution for a blended home and work life schedule. Every employees and all family members are able to see schedules tasks and appointments all in real time regardless of which platform I use. I can add an event to google and automatically it’s added to my  Apple calendar and my planner. No more copying and pasting everything. This saves me so much time!! Employees can  add their time off requests, any notes for me to review, completed tasks, my family can add their upcoming appointments ,school events & chores list that is a set schedule on their personal Apple calendar or google calendar & I’m able to arrange my week accordingly. 
I only wish there were an option that allowed me to create or import my own personal template insert for my additional note tabs.

reviews.title: So irritated
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app now for almost a year and no matter how many updates the developers set this app still have a lot of issues that should’ve been fixed. Firstly, the app crashes ALOT! and this is even after the latest update. Secondly, as a result of the crash a lot of the information typed before the crash isn’t saved so I have to re-type the information. Thirdly, there is a lag when writing which is really annoying. Either there is a lag or the information that I write isn’t transcribed onto the page. I really wanted to stick with this app because I like a lot of the features but as a doctor with very limited time I can’t stick with an app that have the above issues as it slows me down. Please fix these issues! In the meantime I will have to find another app that can meet my needs. I will return when the app improves.

reviews.title: Loving this App so far!
reviews.text:
It’s a well thought out planner and calendar! Something I needed that I didn’t even know I did until I started using it! I love that you can create notes and planner and calendar all in one place! I love a lot of features and plenty of space to take notes! 

The only con is that I am finding it not syncing between devices. I downloaded this for iPad and my phone and although my Apple account is logged in for both accounts, I’d have to create a whole new calendar and planner on iPhone than iPad. That’s the only con. I wish it synched so whatever I had for iPad is on iPhone. But it’s not a big con since I have been loving it on the iPad and will still likely get the yearly subscription! Thanks for creating something so useful and easy to use!
